interpretation: Deterministic S23 preparation audit. It reports coverage gaps; it does not close C01, C06, S20 or S23, accept research, certify a country or change any runtime, research or art record. Passing its tests does not mean the coverage it reports passes.

periods.date_convention: Production and portrait windows are half-open [from, to). Research boundary days report both the ending and the starting observation.

case_dates.boundaries: Day before, day of and day after every stated handover, death, dissolution, founding or creation day inside the reference period; research attestation days and the day after each.

historical_status.boundary_day: A source states a start or end on this day; the listed observations begin or end here.
historical_status.established: Inside a closed interval whose start and end are both stated (research) or a production term active under party_leadership::historical_on.
historical_status.attested: A research observation is attested on exactly this day.
historical_status.period_attested: A holder was observed sometime in this period; not an exact-day incumbent or a continuous term. Listed as possible, never counted as identified.
historical_status.bracketed: Between two evidence points of one observation; interpolated, not a stated interval.
historical_status.uncertain: Only one-sided or imprecise bounds overlap the date; possible holders are pointers, not incumbents.
historical_status.unknown: The role has evidence, but none covers this date.
historical_status.unresearched: The role has no holder evidence at all.
historical_status.inapplicable: Outside the reference period or the organization/institution does not exist per a stated boundary.

acceptance_classes.accepted: Evidence belongs to a C01 packet with an integration acceptance record (bounded research acceptance, not country certification).
acceptance_classes.pending: Evidence belongs to a C01 packet integrated on 27 September 2026 whose historical acceptance remains pending.
acceptance_classes.unclassified_packet: Evidence belongs to a C01 packet report with neither an acceptance record nor a pending-integration listing.
acceptance_classes.unattributed_intake: Checked-in discovery evidence that no numbered C01 packet report claims; its intake batch and acceptance are not established by this audit.
acceptance_classes.mixed_intake: Evidence mixes accepted packet sources with unattributed discovery sources; the whole observation is not labelled accepted.
acceptance_classes.production_registry: spheres-sim/data/party_leaders.json: the partial production registry the game serves; not reviewed as C01 research.
acceptance_classes.fictional_catalog: Authored future fiction (spheres-web/data/future_candidates_2035.json); never historical evidence.

executive_pairing_basis: Audit pairing by the office named in the 1990 executive row (or, for the successor Russia, the researched presidency). Comparison aid only; it is not an identity reconciliation, office mapping or research acceptance.
